summary: Explore the DORA Foundation's initiatives aimed at improving digital operational resilience. Be part of a community driving change in technology and business.
audienceIntro: This PECB DORA Foundation course is essential for professionals seeking to establish a strong understanding of digital operational resilience within the financial sector. This course is designed for: ICT Risk Managers overseeing digital operational resilience programs. Compliance Officers ensuring adherence to DORA regulatory mandates. Cybersecurity Professionals implementing DORA-aligned security controls. Third-Party Risk Managers assessing ICT service provider dependencies. Financial Sector Consultants advising on DORA compliance strategies. Internal Auditors evaluating ICT risk management frameworks against DORA. Operational Resilience Specialists developing incident response plans. Legal Professionals interpreting DORA's implications for financial entities. Business Continuity Managers integrating DORA into resilience planning. Senior Leaders requiring foundational knowledge of DORA's impact.
modules: Introduction to DORA Concepts and Requirements
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course.
